goals: Verify PiRunner TestSpecification lifecycle and artifact management
Confirm hash verification and locking mechanism integrity
Validate real agent artifact emission and tool call authorization
Test state recovery, conflict detection, and event preservation

tasks.title: Create and accept a TestSpecification describing the current test suite
Verify the accepted TestSpecification artifact contains testSuiteContentHash
Generate a TestSuiteLock and verify it references the exact accepted artifact
Compute live hash and verify it equals the locked hash
Execute authoritative test run using the command from the TestSpecification
Verify TestExecutionResult references the exact specification, hash, command, and repository revision
Emit artifact from the real Pi agent and verify ingestion without synthetic provenance
Attempt unauthorized real Pi tool call and verify it is blocked
Restart the workflow and verify recovery of the same canonical state
Perform deliberate repository mutation and verify expected conflict/HUMAN_GATE behavior
Execute PRESERVE operation and verify evidence is appended without modifying historical events

acceptanceCriteria.statement: PiRunner successfully creates and accepts a TestSpecification artifact describing the current test suite
The accepted TestSpecification artifact contains a valid testSuiteContentHash field
The generated TestSuiteLock references the exact artifact ID of the accepted TestSpecification
The live computed hash of the test suite equals the hash stored in the TestSuiteLock
The authoritative test execution runs the command specified in the TestSpecification
The TestExecutionResult artifact references the exact TestSpecification ID, content hash, command, and repository revision
Artifacts emitted by the real Pi agent are ingested successfully without requiring synthetic provenance
Unauthorized real Pi tool calls are blocked and produce an error or rejection
Restarting the workflow recovers the same canonical state as before the restart
Deliberate repository mutation triggers the expected conflict detection and HUMAN_GATE behavior
PRESERVE operation appends new evidence without modifying or deleting historical events
